CANDIDATE for bd-01M176027HM0AKXXD63MR8VBXJ. Please gate and merge.

  1f6c26447cda59cb6b9956a31a311ffc62924d2f
  branch: window-reducer-gate
  worktree: .worktrees/window-reducer-gate
  parent: f03a8cb (current main at branch cut)
  reserved: features/window.scala + WindowSuite.scala only
  shared checkout is still on main

WHAT CLOSED
  WindowReducer.reduce now refuses non-finite and negative sample weights as
  Missing(Undefined(Custom("features","invalid-sample-weight"))).
  Reduction.reduce already refused; the public reducer door published Observed(NaN).
  WeightedMean polarity is fail-closed (`if tw > 0.0`) so a NaN total cannot compute.
  kernelAt uses the same door.

WHAT I DID NOT DO
  No new UndefinedReason case, no codec touch. Custom is already a first-class
  reason. A named case is a follow-on if you want it.

GATE (archive export of 1f6c264, isolated boot, scalafmtCheckAll LAST, unpiped)
  featuresJVM   54/54
  featuresJS    54/54
  featuresNative 54/54
  lawsJVM       86/86
  compileAll    success
  scalafmtCheckAll success
  GATE_EXIT=0
  export: 31 top entries, build.sbt present

The new tests kill the old door: Mean/Sum/WeightedMean on a NaN-weight sample
must be Missing, not Observed. Mean ignores weight in its arithmetic, so the
assertion is load-bearing for the door rather than for WeightedMean polarity.

I hold the two reserved paths until merge.
